  [

  corrections,
  if(
    corrections.inArray(cells["eva_nr"].value.toString() + "|" + value.toString()),
    "0" + value.toString(),
    value
  )
)

Créer la colonne state_slug à l’index 7 sur la base de la colonne state à l’aide de l’expression grel:if(
  isBlank(value),
  null,
  value
    .replace("ü", "ue")
    .replace("ö", "oe")
    .replace("ä", "ae")
    .replace("ß", "ss")
    .replace("Ü", "Ue")
    .replace("Ö", "Oe")
    .replace("Ä", "Ae")
    .replace("ẞ", "SS")
    .replace(/[()]/, "")
    .replace(/\s+/, "-")
    .replace(/-+/, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/, "")
)
